name: 20158 · Hamilton, VA
findings: ZIP 20158 (Hamilton) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20158 (Hamilton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 20158 (Hamilton) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
